name: @speedora/video-validation
description: Stateless module (JSON-in/JSON-out): Quality Validation's Warning/Info-tier rule evaluation over ffprobe'd video metadata. No DB/queue/subprocess access at all - see root ARCHITECTURE.md. Consumed by apps/worker's probe-video adapter. Error-tier findings (no video/audio stream, corrupted file, zero duration) are NOT evaluated here - apps/worker/src/workers/probe-video.worker.ts fails the job outright for those before this module ever runs.
